label: Edimax Gemini RE23S AC2600 Wi-Fi roaming repeater
description: Edimax Gemini RE23S - wall-plug AC2600 dual-band Wi-Fi repeater/access point: one 10/100/1000 Ethernet LAN port, 802.11ac 4-stream MU-MIMO radios at 800 Mbps on 2.4 GHz and 1733 Mbps on 5 GHz, two detachable external antennas, browser-based iQ Setup. Mains powered from an integrated AC plug.
notes: One Ethernet port, and it is **LAN only** in the modes the page describes (repeater, bridge, and AP mode fed by a wired router) - there is no WAN socket, because this is not a router. Rate figures are quoted per band: 2.4 GHz 800 Mbps and 5 GHz 1733 Mbps, four streams with MU-MIMO. Power is an **integrated AC plug** (100-240 V), so `poeIn: 0` is stated rather than left to the access-point heuristic: nothing on this device accepts power over the cable, and it has no battery either. Setup is browser-based iQ Setup, so `http-server` and no `cli`.
